title: Guidelines for Hydraulic Model Studies of Barrages and Weirs
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the requirements for model studies of barrages/weir. It includes types of model, selection of scale, data required for model studies and observations to be taken on the model and the parameters to be finalized from model studies.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Hydraulic design of barrages and weirs - Guidelines, Part 1: Alluvial Reaches

clause_3_terminology: Guidelines for Hydraulic Model Studies of Barrages and Weirs

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
